Chapter 13: James the Less and the Unsung Apostles.
Some apostles seem to live almost completely in the shadows of history. Take James the Less, for instance. He’s only mentioned briefly, and we don’t know much about his story. But isn’t that a powerful reminder? Not every story gets told in detail, yet every single life truly matters.
The early Christian community was filled with people just like James—faithful, steady, and often overlooked. They were the ones who served quietly, supported others, and encouraged those around them, all without expecting any kind of recognition. Their contributions might’ve been silent, but they were absolutely essential to the movement’s growth and stability.
Now, let’s be honest. Most of us feel discouraged when our efforts go unnoticed. It’s human nature. But the story of James the Less—and others like him—gently reminds us that significance isn’t really about fame. Every little act of kindness, every moment when you show support, it all adds up and makes a difference.
So, if you ever find yourself wondering whether your work truly matters, remember these unsung apostles. The world isn’t changed only by the famous or the heroic, but by countless ordinary people, quietly doing small things with great love.
